text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to enact the By-law for the new traffic control signals that have been installed at the intersection of Rexdale Boulevard and Silver Reign Drive. A By-law enactment is also requested by Transportation Services for the dual westbound left turn lanes that have been installed at the intersection. Traffic control signals and the dual westbound left turn lanes at the intersection will provide enhanced safety for all road users. A companion report, "Traffic Control Signal Modifications - 2200 Islington Avenue (Non-Delegated)," outlines the required by-law amendments to reflect traffic control signal modifications and other regulatory amendments for locations with Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) service.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the traffic control signals at the intersection of Rexdale Boulevard and Silver Reign Drive. 2. Designated the two southerly westbound lanes on Rexdale Boulevard between Silver Reign Drive and a point 50 metres east, for westbound left turns only.
